{{Top|leg}}
A '''sensor shroud''' was a piece of equipment designed to made a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] harder to detect. The [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Vindicator (light freighter)|''Vindicator'']] was equipped with a sensor shroud that made it harder to detect the ship at long range.<ref name="IAG">''[[Introductory Adventure Game]]''</ref> [[Talon Karrde]]'s personal ship, the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', was equipped with a sophisticated sensor shroud that rivalled those found aboard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy ship/Legends|spy ships]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
